title: EVOLV Sentinel Traceability Graph
description: GxP-compliant bidirectional traceability graph linking URS/FS requirements to code modules and IQ/OQ/PQ test scripts. Supports forward (code → test) and backward (test → requirement) tracing for change impact analysis.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this schema. Increment minor for backward-compatible additions; major for breaking changes.

graph_id.description: Unique identifier for this traceability graph instance. Used to cross-reference audit trail records.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of graph generation.

generated_by.description: Agent or user ID that created or last modified this graph. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail linkage.

integrity_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the serialized graph content (excluding this field). Used for tamper detection.

requirements.description: All URS and FS requirements covered by this traceability graph.

req_id.description: Unique requirement identifier. Format: URS-X.Y or FS-X.Y

criticality_score.description: Numeric weight used in Impact Score formula. High=3, Medium=2, Low=1.

gxp_category.description: GxP direct impact classification per GAMP 5 Appendix M.

regulatory_reference.description: Citation to the regulatory source (e.g., GAMP 5 section, 21 CFR Part 11).

parent_req_id.description: Parent requirement ID for hierarchical decomposition (null if top-level).

code_modules.description: All code modules and specific functions tracked in this graph.

module_id.description: Unique identifier for this code module.

file_path.description: Relative path from project root. Used to match against git diff output.

functions.description: List of tracked functions/methods within this module.

function_name.description: Exact Python function or method name.

class_name.description: Parent class name if this is a method; null for module-level functions.

line_start.description: Starting line number in the source file (for diff matching).

line_end.description: Ending line number in the source file (for diff matching).

criticality_override.description: Optional function-level risk override (e.g., a low-risk module may contain a single high-risk function).

test_scripts.description: All IQ/OQ/PQ/UAT test scripts that validate requirements in this graph.

script_id.description: Unique test script identifier. Matches DeltaAgent output script_id.

execution_priority.description: Priority for re-execution scheduling after a change impact.

automation_status.description: Whether the test can be executed automatically.

owner.description: Role or team responsible for executing this test script.

last_executed_at.description: Timestamp of last execution. Used to calculate test staleness.

traceability_links.description: The core traceability edges of the graph. Each link connects one requirement to one code module to one or more test scripts.

link_id.description: Unique identifier for this traceability edge.

function_names.description: Specific functions within the module that implement this requirement. Empty array means the entire module is implicated.

test_script_ids.description: Foreign keys → test_scripts[].script_id. All scripts that must be re-executed if this link's module changes.

change_impact_type.description: Whether a change to the linked module directly or indirectly affects the requirement.

rationale.description: Free-text explanation of why this module implements this requirement.

verified_by.description: User ID who verified this link (21 CFR Part 11 attestation).
